text:
Samira: Found S3 object in partner-bucket that looks like Vault transit ciphertext, key=ci/artifacts/workspace_vault_transit_blob.bin (prefix `vault:v1:`).
sec-bot: Alert: external-object-read detected -> incident 3476549999.
Jason: paste s3 path + first ~80 chars of blob (no plaintext).
Samira: s3://partner-bucket/ci/artifacts/workspace_vault_transit_blob.bin -> header `vault:v1:01ab3c...f4d`.
Irfan: transit ciphertext means anyone with transit/unwrap could decrypt if they had API access.
Oncall: immediate containment: revoke partner binding + disable partner SA keys.
Oncall: gcloud iam roles revoke-binding --project=infra-onboard --member="serviceAccount:partner-ci@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/vault.proxy"
Irfan: rotate transit key (vault write -f transit/keys/app-transit-key/rotate) then rewrap affected blobs (vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext="<old>" key="app-transit-key").
Maria: enable Vault audit for transit endpoints and ship logs for 90d (vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_transit_audit.log).
Jason: audit check shows failed unwraps (403) from partner-SA on 2026-03-18 and 2026-03-19; no successful unwraps in last 90d. Still proceed with rotation and RBAC tightening.
Samira: scanning partner buckets - found 2 blobs with `vault:v1:` -> uploaded list to /sec/artifacts/3476549999.txt and alerted partner SOC/legal with scrubbed keys only.
Maria: assign followups: Samira artifact list, Irfan run rotate+rewrap (canary->prod), Jason audit timeline, Oncall collect revocation proof. Schedule review tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
Irfan: rewrap completed for the two blobs, rotation propagated, audits show no unwraps. Marking incident as mitigation.
Maria: good job team :lock:
